canonicalOwnership: VERIFIED: importService (authoritative import domain boundary), ImportSessionManager (session lifecycle + concurrency infrastructure), CanonicalImportPipelineService (parsing + normalization), CanonicalValidationService (validation + deduplication), CanonicalConflictEngine (conflict classification + resolution intents), CanonicalReviewArtifactService (immutable review artifact + canonicalization + SHA-256 content binding), CanonicalReviewApprovalService (human approval decision + artifact binding + stale approval protection), securityService (authorization), auditService (append-only audit events). No competing services introduced.

fivePointArtifactBinding.enforcement: VERIFIED: Evaluated strictly in both evaluateApprovalStatus / isApprovalCurrent and recordApproval.

artifactIntegrityVerification.sequence: resolve artifact -> verify artifact integrity (canonicalReviewArtifactService.verifyArtifact) -> verify session/project binding -> verify artifact identity/version/hash -> authorize reviewer -> concurrency check -> record decision -> transition session

contentHashBinding.mechanism: Direct consumption and cryptographic verification of the SHA-256 digest generated by CanonicalReviewArtifactService.

immutabilityHash.inputPayload: approval immutabilityHash input payload = { importSessionId, projectId, artifactId, artifactVersion, contentHash, reviewerId, approvedAt, decision, concurrencyVersion }

approvalImmutability.model: Object.freeze on created CanonicalApprovalRecord, append-only registry, zero update/overwrite/delete methods exposed.

inMemoryRegistryAnalysis.status: In-memory append-only registry scoped to session lifecycle. No competing state authority or undeclared Firestore mutations. Completely safe and compliant for current runtime model.

approvalStates.distinctStates: APPROVED, REJECTED, STALE, INVALID (strictly separate from session state).

reviewGate.enforcement: Approval rejected from all non-REVIEW_REQUIRED states (SOURCE, PARSED, NORMALIZED, VALIDATED, APPROVED, COMMITTING, COMMITTED, REJECTED, FAILED, STALE, CANCELLED).

sessionTransition.allowedTransitions: REVIEW_REQUIRED -> APPROVED, REVIEW_REQUIRED -> REJECTED; ZERO APPROVED -> COMMITTING transitions.

concurrency.mechanism: ImportSessionManager session.version === concurrency.expectedVersion checked and enforced.

staleApprovalProtection.behavior: V1 approval evaluating against V2 artifact or altered contentHash returns isCurrent=false, status=STALE.

authorization.mechanism: securityService.evaluatePermission with explicit enforcement against read-only roles (VIEWER, FINANCE_AUDITOR) and suspended/inactive accounts.

auditIntegration.mechanism: auditService.logAuditEvent emitting immutable append-only event capturing complete artifact binding.

bypassAnalysis.findings: Zero bypass paths found. All approvals must proceed through recordApproval with full multi-point binding and authorization checks.
